provider.notes: Generated with Microsoft neural ko-KR voices via the edge-tts client, spoken at 0.82× (-18%) for beginners. For a commercial release, regenerate with HANGYUL_TTS_PROVIDER=azure using a paid Azure Speech subscription, which is the licence that covers redistributing synthesised audio inside a product.

repairs.reason: Both ko-KR voices read 닿다 as [닫따] — the word 닫다 — instead of [다타]. Measured 0.0005 from a rendering of 닫따 and 0.0430 from one of 다타; the rest of the ㅎ-final family (낳다, 넣다, 쌓다) is correct from the same voices.
The same defect in the male voice: 0.0007 from 닫따, 0.0287 from 다타.

ko-KR-InJoonNeural palatalises the 디 of the isolated word 마디 and says [마지]. Korean palatalisation applies across a morpheme boundary (굳이 → 구지) and not inside one, so 마디 is [마디]. Reproduced at every speaking rate from +0% to -25%; the other 디 words in the curriculum are correct from the same voice, so this is one lexicon entry rather than a rule. ko-KR-HyunsuMultilingualNeural reads it correctly.

Both ko-KR voices misread the ㄻ cluster of 옮다: the recording measures as [옴다] rather than [옴따] (0.004 from 옴다, 0.098 from 옴따). The cluster itself is not the problem — 삶다, 닮다, 굶다 and 젊은이 are all correct from the same voices — so this is a lexicon entry. The engine is handed the spoken form [옴따] instead of the spelling; the word on the card, its id and its file are unchanged.
